computedRatios.definitionExcerpt: " Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio " means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) (i) Consolidated EBITDA, less (ii) Consolidated Unfinanced Capital Expenditures, (iii) less the aggregate amount of federal, state, local and foreign income taxes paid in cash, less (iv) Restricted Payments made pursuant to Section 9.4(a)(iv) paid in cash, less (v) the aggregate amount of payments made in respect of Permitted Seller Debt or any other earn-out obligation to (b) the sum of (i) Consolidated Interest Expense to the extent paid in cash (excluding imputed interest charges with respect to Capitalized Lease Obligations attributable to a Permitted Sale and Leaseback Transaction), (ii) the aggregate principal amount of all regularly scheduled principal payments of Indebtedness (without giving effect to any reduction of such regularly scheduled principal payments resulting from the application of any voluntary or mandatory prepayments made during the applicable period), including in respect of all Capital Leases, but excluding any such payments to the extent refinanced through the incurrence of additional Indebtedness otherwise expressly permitted under Section 9.1 , in each case, of or by the Parent and its Subsidiaries for the most recently completed Measurement Period.
computedRatios.note: Definition is cite-bound. Unbound operands: Consolidated EBITDA, Permitted Seller Debt. No proxy was substituted.

computedRatios.definitionExcerpt: " Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio " means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) (i) Consolidated Funded Indebtedness minus (ii) unrestricted domestic cash and Cash Equivalents of the Loan Parties in an amount not to exceed $25,000,000 to (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the four fiscal quarters most recently ended.
computedRatios.note: Definition is cite-bound. Unbound operands: Consolidated Funded Indebtedness, Cash Equivalents, Consolidated EBITDA. No proxy was substituted.
